description: This file contains utility functions for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) to a backend API, specifically tailored for managing work items and comments within a project management or bug tracking context. It defines functions for creating, retrieving, updating, and commenting on work items, with detailed comments and error handling.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns parsed JSON (if any) or null. Throws on non-2xx responses.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with a message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, ensuring proper URL encoding, and returns parsed JSON.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item based on project_id and item id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a specified work item.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item (task or bug) with specified details.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds the full URL for an API path using the current base URL.

ctags.name: addWorkItemComment
ctags.pattern: /^export async function addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })

ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status }) {$/
